newsitem.title: USA: Apple software chief steps down.
newsitem.headline: Apple software chief steps down.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc. said Monday that the head of its computer operating system division, Isaac Nassi, resigned from the company to pursue other interests.
A spokesman for the company said the move was announced internally to Apple employees on Friday.
Nassi headed the Applesoft Division of the computer company for the last two years.
Apple declined to elaborate on Nassi's reason for leaving, including whether it was the result of disagreements over the company's direction under Chairman and Chief Executive Gilbert Amelio.
Apple has been widely rumoured to be interested in buying Be Inc., a start-up firm founded by former Apple executive Jean-Louis Gassee, a move which could allow Apple to improve its operating system.
Apple said Nassi's duties will be assumed by Ellen Hancock, Apple's new chief technology officer.
Apple's stock lost 25 cents to $24.75 in late trading on the Nasdaq market.
